items.text: In one early intervention in psychosis service, can peer support workers be introduced and evaluated so that uptake, six-month retention, delivery and questionnaire completion meet pre-set criteria for a definitive trial?
items.population: Young people aged 14 to 35 on the early intervention caseload who are eligible for peer support
items.intervention: Offer of one-to-one peer support from a trained peer support worker with lived-experience supervision
items.outcome: Uptake, six-month retention, contacts delivered, questionnaire completion, peer worker wellbeing
items.setting: One early intervention in psychosis service

finer: Feasible with funded posts and routine data; interesting to the service, families and commissioners; novel locally; ethical with assent and consent processes for under-18s; relevant to whether a trial should follow.
summary: One feasibility question against progression criteria.
